data.name: Egg-cremental
data.detailed_description:
A bottomless pit, hundreds of wacky chickens, and countless eggs! Egg-cremental is a first-person incremental tycoon game that strips away complex mechanics to deliver pure addiction, optimization, and the ultimate sense of progression.

Your task is beautifully simple: gather the eggs produced by your feathered friends, hurl them into the mysterious abyss, pocket the cash, and reinvest every penny into pushing your production to absolute madness! There is only one way to find out what lies at the very bottom of the pit: toss more eggs!

🥚 Key Features:

  • Hurl & Earn: Take control in a fully immersive 3D first-person perspective. Launch eggs into the void and enjoy the immediate financial rewards and unparalleled satisfaction of every single drop.

  • Expansive Tech Tree: Invest your profits strategically. Increase your chickens' laying speed, unlock rare and exotic new breeds, multiply egg values, or purchase automated systems for the pit.

  • Manage Your Poultry Army: Start small with basic coop residents and scale up. Discover rare, highly productive, and completely absurd 3D chickens to transform your humble coop into a massive egg-producing factory.

  • Automation & Progression: Optimize your setup as you advance. Set up automatic funnels and collection systems so the eggs flow into the pit entirely on their own while you sit back and watch the numbers skyrocket.

  • Relaxing & Satisfying ASMR Experience: Escape the stress. Immerse yourself in vibrant visuals and the deeply satisfying sound design of eggs plunging into the depths as the hours melt away.

data.short_description: Chickens lay, eggs fall, profits multiply! In this addictive first-person incremental tycoon game, toss eggs into a mysterious, bottomless pit to earn cold hard cash. Spend your riches to unlock an expansive tech tree, upgrade your poultry production, and build your ultimate egg empire!

Minimum:

  • Processor: 2.0 GHz+
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Any Graphics Card
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
